note: The printer fit table (15 Nov): the only source of hole, bore, slot, sleeve, insert and press-fit sizes for make.py parts and topology setups alike (topo/fit.py reads it: fit.bore / across / insert; the setup audit's fit check refuses a round or width drawn near a declared bought part at a size not from here; tools/assembly_check.py holds mates and assembly paths to it). allow: what the drawn size adds to the bought part's nominal (total: on the diameter or across two faces). From the Scout v4 probe coupon (14 Nov, tools/scout_v4_shape.COUPON_PICK) and the Overseer coupons v2 (27 Oct, systems/dimensions.md row Carbon rods). A new coupon result changes a row here, tagged M.
grow_src: a printed face stands this proud of the drawn one: holes ~0.1-0.2 small on the diameter, outer faces fat (the probe coupon) M
mesh_src:
the viewing mesh (parts/

/part.stl) may sit off the print mesh (tools/print_mesh.py)

bond.src: carbon rod in a resin socket: the 3.2 / 6.2 bores for 3 / 6 rods (CLAUDE.md), the resin fills the rest: it only has to go in (Overseer coupons v2, Spark 27 Oct: the largest of the coupon bores fit; OD + 0.3 was loose in PETG)

press.src: a D bore pressed on the N20's 3.0 / 2.5 D shaft: drawn 3.3 / 2.8 (+0.3 on the diameter and across the flat) pushes on by hand, a drop of CA (the probe coupon, Spark 14 Nov: D1 3.0 / 2.5 and D2 3.1 / 2.6 would not go on, D3 3.2 / 2.7 too hard to press home; printed holes come out ~0.1-0.2 small). min_gap: the drawn clearance per side the check accepts, 0.15 less the viewing mesh's 0.05 (D3's 0.1 failed by hand at 0.10 drawn, so a press mate is checked against the shaft's own D, not a round stand-in)

free.src: a bore turning free on an M3 axle or a 3 mm rod: 3.3 (coupon A1, the snuggest of 3.3 / 3.4 / 3.5, all free)

slide.src: a bought body sliding into a printed pocket, sleeve or slot over its length (camera case, SG90 body): the axle's +0.3 plus 0.3 for the long contact and the case's own tolerance; check on the bench

mate.src: a printed part sliding onto another printed part: both faces print GROW fat (0.2 of it gone) + 0.3 running

clear.src: parts that pass each other and must never touch (an assembly path past a neighbour, a moving part)

screw.src: a screw's shank through a printed clearance hole: M2 2.4, M3 3.4

tap.src: a screw cutting its own thread in a printed pilot: M2 1.6, M3 2.6 (the SG90 tab pilots)

close.src: a screw's shank close-fit through a printed hole where it locates the part (the Overseer arms' M3 3.2 as the rod bore, overseer_arm_lib HOLE_D / SLOT_D; the carbon plates' Ø3.1 / 3.0 M; the hub deck's M2 2.2)

port.src: the resin injection port for one 14 G blunt tip (OD 2.11): Ø2.5 (Spark 8 Nov, CLAUDE.md; cage_node_lib PORT_R)

nut.src: a hex nut's pocket across its flats: M3 5.5 -> 5.7 (overseer_arm_lib NUT_AF; not recorded in dimensions.md)

M2.src: M2 heat-set insert hole Ø3.2 (the camera insert posts, Spark 29 Oct by coupon; scout_v4_units_lib M2_INS)

M2.5.src: M2.5 heat-set insert hole Ø3.5 (scout_v4_units_lib M25_INS; the listing's hole)

M3.src: M3 x 5.7 heat-set insert hole Ø4.0 x 6 (scout_v4_units_lib M3_INS, the base and the FC mount; the listing's hole)

M5.src: M5 heat-set insert (D7 x L6) hole Ø6.4 x 8 (box_stand2p_lib; the repo's value until a coupon)

inserts_src: a heat-set insert's hole is the listing's, not nominal + allow: fit.insert(thread) -> the hole diameter
